findings.rule: Article VII.2 (a rule must name its gate; if none exists, write 'Review') and 263-c2 (D5 row cites a real gate)
findings.trigger: The D5 row says the number is 'labelled as keyword coverage, never match, fit or ATS' and names `tools/ci/check-constitution.sh` policy I.3 as its gate. The I.3 regex (check-constitution.sh:85-87) only matches ATS-score and guarantee phrases: a res/values string 'Your match 92' or 'Fit score 92' passes it (verified: grep -E with the I.3 pattern exits 1). DECISIONS.md D5 itself records 'the I.3 regex would not catch match'. The ledger therefore claims an enforcement for the 'never match, fit' part that does not exist.
findings.title: D5 gate cell overstates policy I.3: the regex does not catch 'match' or 'fit' labels
findings.proof: printf 'Your match 92\n' | grep -E '[Yy]our ATS score|ATS score:|[Bb]eats? (the )?ATS|ATS[- ](proof|approved)|[Gg]uaranteed (job|interview|selection|placement|shortlist)' exits 1. Fix in-PR: gate cell 'Policy I.3 (ATS and guarantee phrases); Review for the match/fit label', with no rule-text change.
